architectures.validation: Differential tensor and state replay, HTTP checks, full generation and same-host A–B–B–A performance and memory.
architectures.results: EXP-1601 qualified fixed 32K/512 execution, response and memory. At the common 4992 MiB cache the recorded run measured 1148.825 prefill tok/s, 28.515 decode steps/s, 21478792 KiB peak RSS and 7272 MiB peak process VRAM, with zero swap. See APEX-32K-ACCEPTANCE.md.
architectures.limitations: Frozen and Optimized Hybrid speed targets remain open. RTX 4070 is the exercised device. This reference protects the independent checkpoint while performance work continues.
